# EventBasedMotionDeblurring

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that uses event cameras' asynchronous pixel-level intensity changes to reconstruct sharp images from motion-blurred frames. Enables low-latency, energy-efficient visual processing in neuromorphic systems, critical for real-time TCC/iNEST edge applications.
